text.p: Anglo-Dutch computer services firm CMG Plc said on Monday it had completed the takeover of German software manufacturer Orga Team GmbH which was announced last December.

"The takeover price which CMG is paying totals 14.9 million marks in cash, 75 percent of which will be paid immediately and the remaining 25 percent after two years," CMG said in a statement. It added it would finance this from its own assets.
Orga Team posted a 1996 pre-tax profit of 2.25 million marks on turnover of 8.4 million.
The takeover is expected to contribute to CMG's 1997 profits, the company said.

"The takeover shows that CMG is continuing its policy of strong organic growth, supported by a growing number of acquisitions which strengthen its positions in core markets and main product areas," CMG added.
